blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings year-round on a covered patio or in the working winery, featuring flights of estate grown wines including Pinot noir and other varietals. The winery offers Cellar Door Club memberships with shipments of exclusive wines, special events, and discounts. Visitors can bring dogs on the patio and picnics, and explore the winery grounds and natural spaces with native plants and farm animals.
extraNote: Tasting fee waived with $100 wine purchase or club membership · Cancel club membership up to two weeks before shipment payment process starts · Club shipments typically sent in April and October; timing may vary to avoid heat · Tasting Room at 6451 Hilltop Lane, Dayton, OR 97114 · Year-round
